rows.en: ...Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon) seems to have entered the final phase of that plan.
rows.notes: Committee speaks of Tekkoryu by its kanji name; preserve glossary form.

rows.en: It's too soon.
Yes. The time has not yet come.
So it is that man's doing after all...
rows.notes: The man discussed by the committee remains unnamed here; male pronoun is explicit in source.

rows.en: The deterrent may not work so well next time.
If things go wrong, the effects could reach us, too.
But they are a force we need for the time to come... We cannot lose them here.
rows.notes: They refers to the force needed for the coming time; keep unnamed collective.

rows.en: ...We have no choice. I will revise part of the schedule.
You mean to let him do as he pleases?
That man knows part of the plan. If he goes to Bahbem, we will have trouble.
There is no problem. What that man wants is to open the door to the underworld with his own hands...
rows.notes: Door to the underworld; sentence deliberately trails off.

rows.en: That is far removed from what Bahbem seeks.
So his goal is closer to ours instead?
Yes. ...In any case, that man's wish will be fulfilled.
Even if he himself denies it.
...Understood. Then I will proceed as instructed.
rows.notes: Oki finishes receiving an order before Miku speaks; subject/action restored.

rows.en: Oki...
...Hau Dragon has made a move. Three Hakke robots are heading for Japan.
Three!? Th-then...
Yes. They have completed the last Hakke robot, Omzack of the Lightning... It is said to have power rivaling Zeorymer's.
rows.notes: The completed final robot is Omzack; its power is reported, not confirmed.

rows.en: ...Hau Dragon may intend to challenge us to a final battle.
Your orders assigning you to #部隊名 were just revoked. From now on, you will be under my command again.
rows.notes: Orders release Miku and Masato from secondment; Oki resumes command.

rows.en: Then, what will happen to us...!?
rows.notes: Miku asks what this means for their assignment; deliberate hesitation.

rows.en: ...#部隊名 will coordinate with Federation forces and intercept the Hakke robots.
And you two will strike Hau Dragon's headquarters in Zeorymer.
...I-I understand. I will... tell him.
rows.notes: Miku will tell Masato, whose body presently houses Masaki; sourced male identity.

rows.en: ...The higher-ups intend to make us take responsibility...
rows.notes: Thought: Oki blames the authorities for making his side take responsibility.

rows.en: ...Please. I am asking you to deploy Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Miku requests Masaki to deploy Zeorymer; request direction preserved.

rows.en: And what would deploying it accomplish?
...Tch... This battle is pointless...
Why...!? The reason you stole Zeorymer of the Heavens...
rows.notes: Question begins here and continues in row32.

rows.en: Was to stop Hau Dragon if they ever committed an outrage like this, wasn't it...?
rows.notes: Completes Miku's question begun in row31.

rows.en: Hah! Do I look like such a good man to you?
Like those people in #部隊名, good people who would fight even at the cost of their own lives?
rows.notes: Deliberate follow-up question expanding the comparison in row33.

rows.en: I stole Zeorymer merely as an insurance policy...
Insurance...?
rows.notes: Deliberate echo fragment questioning insurance.

rows.en: Insurance... so I could become the Lord of Hades...!
...Heh. That body... It is hard to believe it is growth-memory silicone.
rows.notes: Masaki mocks Miku's artificial body. Central growth-memory silicone term used; silicone is an inference from body coating, without added mechanics.
uncertain: Central glossary silicone follows body-coating context inference; exact chemistry and licensed English term remain unverified.

rows.en: Your acting is quite good, too, for an inference-based AI...
rows.notes: Masaki mocks Miku's acting as inference-based AI; source-literal central term, no modern AI mechanics.
uncertain: Central glossary inference-based AI is source-literal; independent licensed English terminology unverified.

rows.en: But in the end, you are just a doll.
You're the one who made me!
rows.notes: Miku addresses her maker Masaki; me restores context-settled object of made.

rows.en: Yes...
Back then, whether I stayed with Hau Dragon or fled from them...
rows.notes: Sentence continues in row44; whether he stayed or fled is retained.

rows.en: I expected that I would be killed someday.
rows.notes: Completes row43: Masaki expected eventual murder.

rows.en: They wanted to take Zeorymer and the Dimensional Coupler System from me...
To salvage the "god" in the world beyond the door.
rows.notes: Purpose of taking the machine/system in row45; deliberate continuation fragment.

rows.en: Beyond the door...? A god...?
rows.notes: Thought: Miku echoes the two alarming concepts, with deliberate fragments.

rows.en: ...So I put several pieces in place to awaken after my death. You, too, are one of them... A growing piece of junk.
rows.notes: Several arrangements would awaken after Masaki's death; insulting junk language retained.

rows.en: Please stop!
Aah! Ugh...!
...When I escaped from Hau Dragon, I destroyed their headquarters, but...
rows.notes: Contrasting clause continues in row52.

rows.en: I calculated that they would eventually rise again and resume the Hades Project.
rows.notes: Masaki predicted Hau Dragon would revive and resume its project.

rows.en: And... both in Japan, where I fled, and in Hau Dragon...
rows.notes: Location clause continues in row54.

rows.en: I left my own blood behind. Heh... Heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Completes row53: his blood refers to genetic legacy/clones explained next.
Intentional silence.

rows.en: The Federation and Hau Dragon... Whichever one wins, my clones will remain.
Now do you understand why I will not deploy...!?
If I am to become the Lord of Hades, I can wait until those Hakke bastards have made a wasteland.
rows.notes: Hakke collective left collective; contempt retained as bastards.

rows.en: After every old bastard who tried to use me and everyone swarming round the Black Moon is hurled into the underworld!
rows.notes: Continues row57: Hakke collective are perpetrators; old bastards and Black Moon crowd are victims. Measured overflow compressed, entire threat retained. Root and independent worker2 grammar review: after-clause agent not explicit; passive preserves violent action/all targets without forcing Hakke or Masaki actor.
uncertain: Central glossary Black Moon is a source-literal designation; independent licensed English term unverified.
Omitted agent of hurling is not grammatically fixed; passive retains source ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Heh heh heh. Even if those Hakke bastards defeat me...
rows.notes: Conditional deliberately unfinished; row60 supplies its result.

rows.en: That will also be the very moment the other me in Hau Dragon becomes the Lord of Hades...!
rows.notes: Answers ID59: defeat of this Masaki triggers the other clone becoming Lord of Hades.

rows.en: Two versions of me, fighting with the world at stake! Could there be a better game than this...?!
C-could the clone you left in Hau Dragon be...?!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing question about the clone.

rows.en: A doll like you... has no need to know...!
Guh?! U-ugh...! Ngh...!
rows.notes: Pain vocalizations retained.

rows.en: ! Masa...to...?
rows.notes: Broken name and startled punctuation retained.

rows.en: Don't touch me!!

rows.notes: Miku wordlessly reacts to Masato's refusal.

rows.en: D-damn it... My head...!
rows.notes: Pain-interrupted head fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Masato... No, Masaki Kihara.
rows.notes: Oki corrects his address from Masato to Masaki Kihara.

rows.en: What do you want, Oki...?
As a representative of the Japanese government, I ask you once again...
rows.notes: Request runs into the deployment instruction at71; Oki asks Masaki.

rows.en: Deploy in Zeorymer.
...What if I say no?
I don't want to, but I would have no choice but to resort to mind control.
rows.notes: Oki threatens coercive mind control if Masaki refuses.

rows.en: ...Are you going to kill me again, Oki...?

rows.notes: Nonverbal shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: ...Fifteen years ago, you shot me dead after I escaped from Hau Dragon.
After you received Zeorymer and the fertilized egg registered in it...
rows.notes: Continuation fragment of76; Oki received the egg registered in Zeorymer before killing Masaki.

rows.en: Just as I had expected.
...Then you found Miku in Zeorymer's cockpit...
rows.notes: Source trails after discovery of Miku.

rows.en: I was a fertilized egg, entrusted to foster parents who raised me.
You never realized that Miku herself was the Dimensional Coupler System, Zeorymer's core that you were searching for...
rows.notes: Subject is Oki, not the infant Masaki: accusation resumes after80; Miku is the sought system.

rows.en: After that, you formed Last Guardian, planning to eventually make Zeorymer your own...
rows.notes: Oki remains subject, with83 completing inferred ambition; source trails.

rows.en: I suppose you thought you could fulfill your ambitions that way... How naive you were.
To control Zeorymer, you brought back the man you thought you had killed with your own hands... Yes, me, Masaki Kihara.
rows.notes: Own-hands accusation and self-identification retained.

rows.en: Heh... Heh heh heh... Thanks for all your hard work, Oki.
rows.notes: Mocking thanks rather than sincere gratitude.

rows.en: What are you planning to do, Kihara...?
It's obvious... I'll destroy Hau Dragon so I can become the Lord of Hades...!

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Why... Why is Middi in the Medius...
rows.notes: Middi is sourced surname; source-short Medius retained; trailing thought preserved.

rows.en: Was Middi also... involved in stealing that unit...?
Why did she... spare me...?
rows.notes: Interrupted thought retains ellipses; sparing action restored from94.
uncertain: The interrupted source omits the action after me; spare is inferred from the explicit recollection in94.

rows.en: I don't understand... So much has happened, I don't know what to do...
Middi... I want to know what you're thinking...
Why do we have to fight each other...
rows.notes: Question continues92 thought about Middi; mutual combat is explicit.

rows.en: Why did she let me go that time... I want to know the reason...
Huh...? They sent a Dragoon for #女愛称?
Yes, just a little while ago.
What is going on?
Well... The Tsentr Project's lab shipped it here without consulting us, and that was it...
rows.notes: Unilateral shipment and lack of follow-up; source trails.
uncertain: The trailing and left it at that is read as shipment without further explanation, given the unilateral shipment and colleagues asking what it means.

rows.en: Is it supposed to replace #機体名?
That... seems to be the case.
That's cold of them. After what's happened to #男愛称...
rows.notes: Refers to male lead injury; no unsupported death assumption.

rows.en: So they're saying to carry out your assigned mission, no matter what happens to your partner.
What do the people at the Tsentr Project think #男愛称 and the others are...?!
...I can make a pretty good guess.
rows.notes: Stray Japanese closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: But making #女愛称 fight in a Dragoon in her current state...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished objection; female lead gender supported by lead placeholder.

rows.en: Yeah... That's cruel.
Anyway... Does #女愛称 know about this?
Yes, she was there when we took delivery of the unit...
#女愛称...
What did the project tell you?
They said to get used to piloting humanoid weapons and combat in that Dragoon until the new TE Absorber's adjustments are done...
rows.notes: Female lead reports project order: combat/piloting training while new TE Absorber adjusted. Measured draft overflow compressed; all training, platform, timing and new-unit adjustment meaning retained.

rows.en: That's unreasonable. Your injuries haven't even healed yet...
That's right! You don't have to obey an order like that!
That said, we can't help the fact that they've sent it here.
Captain, surely you're not...
rows.notes: Source-interrupted objection retained.

rows.en: We'll accept it for now. We'll decide for ourselves what to do with it later.
Then you won't have #女愛称 pilot that unit?
Correct. I'll have #女愛称 rest and recover for a while.
rows.notes: Stray wrapper ignored; Ruri arranges female lead recovery.

rows.en: Harry, please handle the report to the Tsentr Project as you see fit.
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry, speaker prefills unchanged; Ruri asks Harry to handle report loosely.

rows.en: Understood.
...No, Captain. I'll fight in that Dragoon.

rows.notes: Silence retained in all nine original contexts.
Name-only alarm fragment; stray wrapper ignored.

rows.en: I... have to challenge Medius Locus.
For my own sake... And for #男愛称's sake, too...
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation of121; purpose phrase remains a fragment.

rows.en: Have you ever piloted a robot on your own?
Yes, during training. Besides, that Dragoon has been specially fitted with a DFC system.
rows.notes: Training answers solo-piloting question; special fitting refers to DFC installation. Yes, during training is an elliptical answer, not omitted pilot subject in an assertion.

rows.en: B-but that's reckless. After what just happened...
rows.notes: Final concessive phrase trails off deliberately; objection addresses the injured protagonist.

rows.en: I can't afford to say that...
I... have to gain more experience.
Otherwise, I'll never be able to understand what Middi is thinking...
rows.notes: Middi is the former mentor; her thoughts are the object of understanding.

rows.en: ...All right. If that's what you want, I won't stop you.
But please don't push yourself too hard.
I understand, Captain.
What's happening?!
Urgent message from the Nahel Argama! They say the Hakke robots are on the move!
Have we heard anything from Last Guardian?
We haven't!
...Then the Nadesico will rendezvous with the Nahel Argama and intercept the Hakke robots.
Everyone, please take your battle stations.
Roger!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. GEAR Fighter Dendoh is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain loss conditions; one @ retained.

rows.en: ...We're heading to Fuji now?! Saiga, what are you thinking?!
What's wrong? Are you afraid of Zeorymer, you stiff?
rows.notes: Stiff preserves the rigid-personality taunt.

rows.en: What did you say?!

rows.notes: Silence retained for all five uses; every occurrence and neighbors checked.

rows.en: ...In the last battle, Zeorymer regained its Dimensional Coupler System.
And even though we've made our move, it hasn't deployed. Something must be going on...
rows.notes: It refers to Zeorymer; no pilot gender inferred.

rows.en: Or perhaps it's being modified to increase its power.
Wouldn't it be wiser for our three robots to destroy it before that happens?
rows.notes: Three robots retained explicitly. Final restores explicit wiser/best-course assessment; meaning correction, not fit compression.

rows.en: You...!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished angry address.

rows.en: Heh... Besides, we can destroy Japan anytime.
Yuratei ordered us to leave Zeorymer alone. Are you going to defy that order?!
...No, Saiga has a point.
Indeed, we have no chance of winning unless we destroy Zeorymer.
Let's head to Fuji... and settle things with Heaven, Giso.
rows.notes: Source-short Heaven retained as Zeorymer epithet.

rows.en: Rockfell, you...!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished address to Rockfell.

rows.en: No, if you say you're going, then I...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing-off after self-subject I.

rows.en: It's settled, then.
Heh...
rows.notes: Scoffing thought interjection.

rows.en: But shouldn't we at least report this to Yuratei?
There's no need. Surely even the Empress couldn't scold whoever defeats Heaven?
rows.notes: Heaven retained source-short; Empress gender/title sourced in glossary.

rows.en: ...Saiga... What on earth are you plotting?
! What is this...?! Saiga, Giso! I'm getting a sensor contact!
rows.notes: Sensor contact subject/action restored.

rows.en: All right, launch!
All units! Don't let the Hakke robots invade the Japan region!
Yes!
rows.notes: Neutral enthusiastic Yes suitable both encouragement use760 and launch order use901.

rows.en: #女愛称! If things get dangerous, fall back right away!
Yes. Thank you for looking out for me.
#男愛称, watch me. I'll show you I can fight, too...!
And I'll meet Middi again and find out what she really intends...!
rows.notes: Middi female gender sourced in glossary; intention belongs to Middi.
